welcome: Leemon here. Click me and type — we can talk or get something done.
model_missing: The language model is not installed yet. Notes and timers already work. Use /help.
model_connection_failed: The local model is unavailable. Check the developer worker or stop the request.
model_invalid_response: The local model returned an unreadable response.
module_unavailable: This module is not connected yet.
help_text:
Try: open notepad; time in Beijing; remind me in 5 minutes check the download; translate clipboard to Russian; walk around. /notes lists notes; /reminders lists reminders.
File review: “edit a file”. Memory: “remember fact color: green”, “my facts”, “forget fact color”. Workflow: “in this window: select Insert → write Search: hello”.
Calculate: /calc sqrt(81) + 2^3
Units: convert 2.5 km to m
Settings: open settings sound
Page: read page https://example.com/
Computed without AI using doubles; results may be approximate. sin/cos use radians; % always divides a number by 100.
agent: show where to adjust font size
Copy all available conversation
timer_invalid: Use /timer with a whole number from 1 to 86,400 seconds.
storage_failed: Could not save. The original file has been preserved.
busy_message: A request is running. Stop it before starting another.
paused_message: The companion is paused. Resume it to continue.
character_hint: Leemon: one master, six parts and 26 procedural poses.
confirm_clear: Delete all {count} notes from this computer? This cannot be undone.
settings_hint: Automatic mode selects a conservative profile. Model memory limits are budgets, not enforced limits in this scaffold.
dev_hint: Adapter: 127.0.0.1:9931. No model or managed worker is included. Disabled on every launch.
privacy_hint: No telemetry. No microphone or screen capture in this build.
session_hint: Conversation stays in this session. Notes and settings are saved.
page_modules_hint: These states describe this build, not a promise that every module is already implemented.
storage_warning: Storage is unavailable. Existing data will not be overwritten.
foundation_notice: Private preview. Local AI modules install separately. Includes 26 procedural poses; finished artistic clips are not bundled.
source_hint: A local foundation for a personal companion.
character_stage_hint: Appearance concept. The model and animations are not produced yet.
character_motion_hint: Articulated 2D rig: 8 procedural states. Internal prototype, without detailed facial animation or frame clips.
search_hint: Your button sends the query to DuckDuckGo in your default browser. Results require internet; the search service receives the query.
search_requested: Search handed to the browser. I have not read or verified the results.
search_failed: Could not hand the search to your browser. Check the query and default browser.
search_intelligence_status: Opening search works. Reading pages, comparing sources and answering with citations are not connected yet.
desktop_controls: Click to chat; hold and drag to move; right click for quick menu. Body rig animation remains pending.
ai_install_hint: Qwen3.5-2B Q4: about 1.3 GB. Optional vision adds 668 MB, speech input adds 69 MB. One heavy task at a time; the model unloads when idle.
ai_scope_hint: Preview text model: chat, translation and explanations. It cannot see your screen or read your browser. Answers can be wrong; speed depends on your PC.
ai_windows_only: This automatic package installer supports Windows x64
ai_install_failed: Installation incomplete. Check connection and free disk space, then retry.
ai_starting: Starting local model… Send your question after it is ready.
ai_worker_failed: The local process could not start or has exited. You can retry.
ai_sleeping: AI unloaded to save memory; starts on your next question.
system_voice: Read replies with a system voice
system_voice_hint: Uses installed Windows voices; the requested language may be unavailable.
capture_hint: Use the chat screen button for one local image analysis. No continuous screen monitoring.
capture_failed: The OS could not capture the screen.
model_context_full: This request exceeds the current AI context budget. Shorten it or choose a larger context profile.
chat_write_hint: Write to me… Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line
browser_hint: Selected Opera opens the query in its normal profile. Reading or controlling existing tabs is not connected.
browser_missing: Selected Opera was not found in standard locations. Check the browser preference.
composer_keys: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
character_controls_short: Click to talk, drag to pick up, right-click for actions. Walks stay within the screen.
self_model_owned: I’m Leemon, your desktop companion. The conversation component is {model}, running locally.
self_model_developer: I’m Leemon. A local developer server is connected; I cannot verify which model it has loaded.
self_model_inactive: I’m Leemon. The conversation model is not running. This build is configured for the {model} package.
self_origin: Leemon is a separate application with a character and a local conversation component. It is not ChatGPT connected over the internet.
self_memory: Notes stay on this PC. Conversation history is optional in settings and can be deleted. Automatic observation and memory are not implemented.
self_offline: Once the model is installed, conversation runs on your PC without internet. Initial downloads and web searches need a connection.
self_offline_uninstalled: The conversation component is not installed yet. Downloading it requires internet; afterwards conversation runs locally. Notes and timers already work offline.
self_load: The Usage page measures process memory and CPU for this app and its owned AI worker. Answer complexity, hardware and other applications affect speed.
self_motion: My articulated 2D character moves its head, arms and legs separately. There are idle, hello, thinking, talking, success, hesitation, grab and walking motions. Detailed facial animation is not ready.
self_power: An application runs me on your PC. Your CPU generates answers with a local model; its data is stored on disk and loaded into memory.
self_capabilities: I can chat locally, calculate expressions, convert units, open an app or a Windows Settings page, tell the time and save reminders. Explicit tools can transcribe speech, analyze one screenshot, read a selected window or excerpts from a public HTTPS page. The editor has reviewed DOCX/XLSX/CSV changes. Window actions require checks and confirmation; not every program or task is supported.
self_weather: I have no current weather data. Use /search weather in your city to open a search; I will not invent a temperature.
self_greeting: Hey. I’m here. How’s it going?
self_identity: I’m Leemon, your desktop companion. Leemon is my name, not yours.
self_offline_developer: A local developer server is connected. I cannot verify whether that server forwards requests elsewhere. The built-in Leemon worker is designed to run offline after installation.
desktop_started: Started {name}. I can’t confirm its window yet.
desktop_missing: I couldn’t find that app. What is its name in Start?
desktop_failed: I couldn’t open it. Try the exact app name.
desktop_timeout: Launch verification timed out. The result is unconfirmed.
desktop_unsupported: Application launching in this build supports Windows.
desktop_browser_handoff: Sent the URL to your selected browser. I cannot read the page yet.
model_action_unverified: I haven’t done that. I can open apps and create new text files, but can’t control arbitrary windows yet.
confirm_clear_chat: Delete saved history and current messages?
history_hint: Up to 100 messages / 256 KiB. Off by default. Disabling saving keeps any existing file; use Delete to erase it.
diagnostics_hint: Updates every 5 seconds while this page is open. CPU needs two samples. The FPS limit is a target, not a measured guarantee.
reminders_hint: Stored on this PC. Missed reminders appear when the app next starts. Up to 32 reminders, scheduled within 31 days.
reminder_invalid: Provide a delay from 1 second to 31 days and reminder text.
clock_missing: This city is not in the offline directory. Use an IANA zone such as Europe/London, or a nearby major city.
clock_ambiguous: Several time zones match. Specify one:
clock_expired: The bundled timezone table does not cover this date. An app update is needed.
clipboard_too_long: This mode accepts up to 4096 characters.
clipboard_language: Choose Russian, English or Chinese for translation.
clipboard_local_required: Start the built-in local AI to translate the clipboard. I do not read it without that worker.
clipboard_hint: "Translate clipboard to English" reads text only on that command and sends it to the owned local model. Source text is not added to history.
reply_limit: The reply reached its length limit and may be incomplete.
chat_setup_hint: Install the conversation model once. It runs on this PC without a cloud service.
document_failed: I couldn’t save the file. Existing files were left untouched.
desktop_document_opened:
Created “{name}” and opened it in Notepad.
{path}
desktop_document_started:
Created “{name}” and sent it to Notepad. Its window is not confirmed yet.
{path}
desktop_document_saved:
Saved “{name}”, but couldn’t open it in Notepad.
{path}
desktop_edit_unavailable: I can’t edit an existing window yet. Try “create a file in notepad: your text”.
model_repeated: I’m repeating myself. That reply didn’t work — please try rephrasing.
voice_install_hint: Local Russian, English and Chinese dictation. The microphone runs only on request; review the text before sending.
voice_recording: Listening… click the mic again to finish
voice_silence: That recording was too quiet. Try speaking closer to the microphone.
voice_microphone_unavailable: Couldn’t start the microphone. Check the input device and Windows microphone access.
voice_audio_invalid: The recording must be between 0.25 and 20 seconds.
voice_timeout: Transcription took too long. Try a shorter recording.
voice_no_text: I couldn’t make out the words. No text or commands were sent.
vision_install_hint: Vision is an optional 668 MB module. The button takes one reduced image and analyses it on this PC. The image is not saved to disk.
vision_need_ai: Install the conversation model using the button in chat first.
vision_failed: I could not analyse that image. I have not performed any screen actions.
vision_stale: The image became stale while AI was starting. Press the screen button again.
vision_default_question: Briefly describe what is visible on the screen and how you can help. Do not guess small details.
access_choose: Choose a window using the button next to the microphone. I only work with that selected window.
access_refresh: The element list is stale. Refresh it with ↻.
access_ambiguous: I could not find one available element named “{name}”. Refresh ↻ and use its exact label.
access_unavailable: The window did not expose a suitable accessible element for this action.
access_windows: Choose an application from the window list.
access_confirmation: “{name}” may send data or change the system. Confirm with the separate button in chat.
access_invoked: Invoked “{name}”. The application outcome has not yet been verified.
access_written: Entered and verified the text in “{name}”.
access_not_empty: The field already contains text. To preserve it, use “append Field name: text”.
access_write_unsupported: This field does not support safe accessible text entry. I did not change it.
access_write_unverified: The application accepted the text command, but I could not verify the text. Please check the field.
access_invoke_unsupported: That element does not expose a supported action.
access_stale: The window or element has changed. Refresh ↻.
access_unsupported: Window actions are available in the Windows build.
access_failed: I could not verify an action in the chosen window. I will not claim it succeeded.
goal_local_only: Window assistance requires the installed local AI.
goal_need_ai: Install the conversation model using the chat button first.
goal_more_info: I could not identify one clear step among the accessible controls. Clarify the goal or choose another window.
goal_failed: I could not prepare or verify the step. Check the selected window.
goal_changed: The window or control changed. The proposal was cancelled.
goal_expired: This step expired. Request a fresh one.
goal_unverified: The action result could not be verified. Check the selected window.
goal_propose_write: In “{window}”, I suggest entering this text into the empty “{name}” field:
goal_propose_append: In “{window}”, I suggest appending this text to “{name}”:
goal_written: Entered and verified the text in “{name}”.
goal_invoked: Pressed “{name}”. The overall task outcome inside the application has not been verified.
goal_button: Agent: goal for the selected window
window_read_default: Briefly explain what is visible in the selected window.
window_read_empty: No accessible text could be read from this window. You can separately share one screen image with the capture button.
window_read_failed: Could not reliably answer from this window. Refine the question or read it again.
window_read_expired: Reading expired. Read the window again for a fresh answer.
window_read_insufficient: The excerpts do not contain an answer. Refine the question or open the relevant part of the window.
window_read_partial: Partial text at request time · not saved in chat history.
workflow_invalid: Use two to four steps separated by → or new lines. Quoted text stays in one step.
workflow_start: Plan for the selected window. Each step needs your review and approval:
workflow_done: Every step in the sequence was completed and verified.
workflow_unverified: The button was invoked, but its outcome is unverified. I stopped the sequence; check the window.
workflow_stopped: Remaining steps cancelled. Completed changes are not automatically undone.
file_patch_hint: Enter an exact fragment and its replacement. Review the change before writing; a local backup is kept. UTF-8 text up to 1 MB is supported.
file_patch_preview: One change at line {line}. A backup will be created before writing.
file_patch_written: File changed and verified. A local backup was saved.
file_patch_receipt: Changed “{name}” and verified the saved bytes. The previous version is kept locally.
facts_empty: No explicit facts yet. Example: “remember fact color: green”.
fact_saved: Fact saved. Use the same command to update it, or “forget fact key” to remove it.
fact_failed: Could not save the fact. Key: up to 96 characters; value: up to 512; up to 1024 records.
file_status_unsupported: this path or file type is not supported yet
file_status_unreadable: file is unavailable or larger than 1 MB
file_status_input: a non-empty, meaningful replacement is required
file_status_ambiguous: the original fragment must occur exactly once
file_status_approval: preview expired or was already used
file_status_changed: file changed; create a fresh preview
file_status_write_failed: file is locked or write access is unavailable
file_status_unverified: write could not be verified; inspect the file and backup
self_updates: Added short composed drafts for supported fields of a selected application: review the complete text before approving entry. The agent re-observes after verified steps. Compact choices now bind each action to its supported element. Universal autopilot is not ready.
ai_memory_low: Not enough available RAM to start the AI right now. Lightweight tools still work; free some memory and retry.
queue_unavailable: The queue is full or this task requires a separate start. Your text remains in the input.
table_hint: CSV uses commas; TSV uses tabs. Indices start at 1 and include the header. Left: exact current cell value. Right: new value. Review and approval required. Formulas are never evaluated.
file_status_table_invalid: malformed or ragged CSV/TSV; CSV requires commas
file_status_table_limit: table exceeds 10,000 rows, 256 columns or 50,000 cells
file_status_table_formula: formula input is not supported by the cell editor
table_value_loaded: Current value loaded. Enter the new value on the right and review it.
office_hint: DOCX: unique text in one plain paragraph, including adjacent styled runs. XLSX: existing cell with an explicit type; formula workbooks are not edited. Numbers use a decimal point; Boolean values use true or false.
file_status_office_package: Office package is damaged, too large or contains unsupported parts
file_status_office_xml: unsupported Office structure: protection, revisions, metadata or XML
file_status_office_text: Text is not unique in a supported plain paragraph. Fields, hyperlinks and hidden text are not edited.
file_status_office_formula: workbook contains formulas; recalculation is not supported yet
task_file_review: The change is ready for your review and approval.
task_file_verified: File written and verified. The original is backed up.
task_file_failed: The change was not verified. Check the reason in the editor.
task_model_loading: Loading the local model. Your request is waiting for it.
task_reply: Preparing a reply. You can queue the next messages.
queue_clear: Clear waiting messages and continue the current reply
resource_hint: Economy uses one thread, a small processing batch and unloads AI after 30 idle seconds. Replies may take longer. This is not a hard CPU or RAM limit.
file_status_office_value: Invalid type or value. Number: decimal point, up to 15 significant digits; Boolean: true / false.
range_hint: No AI or file writes. Up to 1024 cells. XLSX uses raw numbers without interpreting date/percent formats; text and Boolean values are excluded. CSV/TSV numbers use a decimal point. Approximate double arithmetic; not exact monetary totals.
math_precision: Computed without AI using doubles; results may be approximate. sin/cos use radians; % always divides a number by 100.
math_syntax: Cannot parse the expression. Example: /calc sqrt(81) + 2^3. Use a decimal point.
math_domain: Undefined result or numeric limit exceeded. Check division by zero, roots and powers.
math_limit: Expression too long or deeply nested. Split it into parts.
math_units: Unknown or incompatible units. Example: convert 2.5 km to m. MB uses decimal bytes; MiB uses binary bytes.
settings_page_requested: Windows Settings launch was requested. No settings were changed; the window has not been verified.
settings_page_platform: This shortcut is available only on Windows.
settings_page_unsupported: This Settings page is not supported.
settings_page_failed: Could not request the Windows Settings page.
web_url: Use an explicit public HTTPS URL with a regular domain, no credentials and port 443. Encode Unicode paths.
web_connection: Could not establish a verified HTTPS connection.
web_address: The domain resolved to a local, reserved or unsupported network. Request stopped.
web_redirect: The site redirects this request. Redirects are not followed automatically; supply the final HTTPS URL.
web_http: The site did not return an open page (HTTP 200). No login or restriction bypass is performed.
web_content: Only uncompressed UTF-8 HTML/plain text is supported. This response could not be read.
web_empty: No readable text in the returned HTML. The page may require JavaScript or login.
web_partial: These are limited excerpts, not a complete browser view or a verification of the site. No JavaScript, forms or page commands were executed. URL and excerpts are excluded from saved chat history.
math_conventions: sin/cos use radians; % always divides a number by 100.
agent_start: I will try this goal in the selected window. Up to {limit} verified steps, each proposed for your approval first.
agent_invalid: Provide one goal up to 600 characters for the selected window. Negative or ambiguous instructions are not executed yet.
agent_review: Stopped: the model did not propose another grounded step. The overall task outcome is not verified.
agent_no_actions: Stopped: no further supported action is available. The overall task outcome is not verified.
agent_budget: This run reached its step limit. The overall task outcome is not verified.
agent_expired: Stopped: time expired or the selected window changed.
agent_stale: The observation is stale. Check the selected window and start again.
agent_unverified: Stopped because the last action result could not be verified.
chat_copy_failed: Could not copy conversation. Check clipboard availability or history size.
chat_copy_retained: This is all retained conversation. Earlier messages were removed by the history limit and are not included.
self_chat_export: Copy all available conversation with the ⧉ button beside chat status, or say “copy whole chat”. Messages already removed by the history limit cannot be recovered with this button.
self_desktop_edit: The app can create text documents, review and back up changes to selected files, and enter text into supported fields of a selected window after approval. A chat reply alone does not type into Notepad. Universal editing inside every application is not ready.
self_limits: Reliable universal autopilot, full document/formula handling, a verified custom voice and testing across Windows PCs are still missing. The small model can make mistakes. There is a bounded selected-window loop, files, calculations and other tools; only verified effects count as completed.
goal_propose_draft: Draft for “{name}” in “{window}”. Nothing has been entered. Review the complete text below; approval fills an empty field or appends to its existing text, without sending:
model_reasoning_failed: The answer remained contradictory after one retry. Try asking one question separately.
experimental_answer_review_hint: Off by default: an extra pass is slower and did not improve accuracy in the current trial. For experiments only.
draft_unprovided_detail: The draft added a number, time or address absent from your request. It will not be entered. Specify those details or ask for text without them.
